problem_heading: One team for both sides of the petition

problem_cards.title: For employers
problem_cards.body: Petitions prepared to the corporate standards founding attorney Sam Faragalla trained on at Fragomen — position analysis, compliant filings, RFE-resistant records, and realistic timelines your HR team can plan around.

problem_cards.title: For professionals and founders
problem_cards.body: If your employer won't sponsor or you're building your own company, we tell you which categories don't need one — O-1, E-2, TN, and self-petitioned green cards (NIW, EB-1) — and whether your profile supports them.

problem_cards.title: Category-honest from the first call
problem_cards.body: The most expensive mistake in employment immigration is filing the wrong category. We map the role and the person to the visa that can actually be approved — and tell you plainly when the answer is to wait or build the profile first.
